meta.purpose: Master worklist for the hourly Visualize-scene author (medbank-viz3d-corpus). The task walks this structure-by-structure, authoring one VisualScene per structure in SCHEMA v2 (model3d-scene-spec-v2.md), then running tools/validate-scenes.mjs and tools/build-scene-index.mjs. A scene that fails validation is written status:"blocked" and never counted as done.
meta.narrative: Each structure scene tells: (1) see it in the body, (2) see it among associated organs, (3) see how it works — plus cross-section / contraction-filter / vasculature / glands where the structure needs them.
meta.itemsPerRunRationale: 207 structures total across the 4 courses. Each structure bundles several authored + validated views (location, associated organs, mechanism, cross-section, vasculature, muscle filter). 2 structures/run is the sweet spot: each still gets full precise multi-view authoring with every mesh URL verified, while finishing in ~104 runs instead of 207. Do not exceed 2 — beyond that, per-scene precision and URL validation suffer.

viewModes.location: Highlight the structure inside its whole region / body context.
viewModes.associated_organs: Show it among neighbouring organs/structures, each its own labelled mesh.
viewModes.mechanism: Animate the function — how it works (pumping, peristalsis, breathing, CSF/bile flow, reflex).
viewModes.cross_section: Cut plane revealing chambers, spaces, or layers.
viewModes.contraction_filter: Relaxed to contracted toggle for skeletal muscle (e.g. flexing the biceps).
viewModes.vasculature: Arteries and veins in/around the structure, correctly positioned (own meshes, red/blue).
viewModes.glands: Associated glands and a note on their secretion.

modeRouting.principle: Mode is a property of the LEARNING CONCEPT, never of the subject it sits in. Each course carries defaultModes; each structure carries preferred_modes - an ORDERED fallback list. The author takes the first mode an engine can render today and keeps the rest on the record. This is deliberate: today's provider coverage must never harden into a permanent curriculum rule. A structure routed to `diagram` now becomes a 3D scene the day a mesh for it exists, with no curriculum edit.
modeRouting.assignment: Assigned by what is being TAUGHT, not by what BodyParts3D happens to hold. A concept whose subject is a process (conduction, circulation, gametogenesis, a mechanism) leads with diagram/sequence even in Gross Anatomy. A tissue-level concept leads with microscopic. Everything spatial leads with 3d_anatomy. Whether a mesh exists is decided per structure at authoring time by the validator - not here.

modes.3d_anatomy: spatial relationships, nerves, vessels, organs, muscles, pathways - viz3d.js + a provider adapter
modes.microscopic: histology, pathology, cellular structure - the existing SVG Visualize engine
modes.diagram: physiology, pathways, algorithms - the existing SVG Visualize engine
modes.sequence: ordered developmental or process stages - the SVG engine, played as beats
modes.comparison: X vs Y, differentials - either engine, driven by COMPARE_STRUCTURES
modes.imaging: X-ray/CT/MRI/ultrasound - NO engine yet; author as status:"planned"

meshCoverageEstimate.note: Loose name match against the 934-mesh catalog, for planning only - NOT used to assign modes. gross 45/81, neuro 16/34, embryo 11/46, histology 15/46; the last two are mostly false positives.
